Peppa is out with Suzy and Granny Sheep. They come across an old van that Miss Rabbit is recycling. Granny Sheep decides she would like to turn it into an art van.
Gabby finds a book with the same doodle on every page; inside the dollhouse, the Gabby Cats use their imagination to add their own spin to the drawings.
Lights in the Night: Stan is intrigued when he spots strange lights in the night sky. Grumblestunk thinks it's an alien invasion, but Stan and Gran are not so sure... (S1, ep 24)
It's Pie Swap Day! Humdinger sends Rocky Kitty to take one of Mr. Porter's tasty pies, so he can join the contest.
Something Fishy Going On: A fish has gone missing from Grandad's pond and his plastic 'scare' heron appears to have come to life! Stan and Gran suspect something fishy is going on! (S1, ep 25)
When Ms. Marjorie brings her bookmobile to Everest and the kids of the mountains, Maynard accidentally sets the van rolling and goes off on a wild ride.

Farmer's snails are tired of their life of toil and decide to go on strike and join Wild for a life of freedom; the Smurfs prepare their sarsaparilla banquet, unaware that Gargamel has enchanted the thicket.
pr.sub: The Snail Whisperer; Smurfs Might Fly

pr.d: Shooting Star: Tim, Tommy, Tia and Dad get stuck on a remote asteroid. (S1, ep 1)
A superfood cake creates some super heroes in 'Paddington's Hero Squad', then in 'Paddington's Knightly Quest', Paddington wants to become a Knight; but needs to complete heroic quests.
Tidy: Tim has a clear out of all his old stuff but soon finds not all of it is destined for the rubbish tip. (S1, ep 38)
Balloon: Tia's new balloon gets stuck in a tree, so Tim tries to get it down. (S1, ep 3)
A game between England and Peru causes 'Paddington's Football Dilemma', then in 'Paddington Has To Say Goodbye', it's time for Aunt Lucy to go home, but there's still one more adventure. (S3, ep 24)
When Camila the truck driver needs a place to stop and eat, the pups and Café Carl have a fancy idea. Park Ranger Rose and Rosie the goat are putting on a show, but Rosie disappears.
pr.sub: The Crew Builds a Fancy Drive-Thru Restaurant; The Crew Builds a Castle Show

pr.d: Sid Swashbuckle the Pirate and his first pup mate, Arrby, steal the giant pearl-making shell that gives Puplantis its magic.
Penny Polar Bear's Party: It's the day of Penny Polar Bear's party! The children find out they will be playing ice hockey! They have great fun learning to play. (S8, ep 18)
It's the annual fun run in Windsor Gardens park in 'Paddington Gets Fit', then in 'Paddington's Rocking Chair Repair', Mrs. Bird's much-loved rocking chair accidentally gets broken.
Biggest Picture in the World: Mr Meerkat shows the children a huge wall that needs painting. They create a fantastic mural using lots of different techniques - and even a paint cannon! (S8, ep 19)
Duck Race: It's the day of the duck race! When Miss Rabbit gives the sign, everyone drops their ducks in the river at the first bridge - whose will make it to the second bridge first? (S8, ep 20)
Martial Arts: At the gym, Madame Gazelle is teaching the children about martial arts. Along with Mr Bull, the children learn how to fall safely, balance and how to take the right stance! (S8, ep 21)
While celebrating Friendship Day, the pups must prevent Mayor Humdinger from ruining Adventure Bay's reputation as the friendliest town on the map.
Dr Hamster's Ant Farm: Dr Hamster is visiting the playgroup today and has brought a giant ant farm. But nobody notices when they escape and start moving things in the classroom! (S8, ep 22)
Tim, Tommy & Tia find a lost toy and vow to return it to its owner.
Grownup Playground: Peppa spots a new playground! The children race over to it and discover that it's rather odd. Grampy Rabbit explains, this isn't a playground - it's an exercise park! (S8, ep 23)
Tim, Tommy and Tia take on their parents at Tailball.
Run Daddy Run: Daddy Pig thinks perhaps he should run the London Marathon to teach his children about determination! Daddy enlists Peppa and George to help with training in the park. (S8, ep 24)
Coach Peppa: Daddy Pig's marathon training continues. There isn't long to go before the big day! Peppa takes the role as Daddy's coach and, with George, devises lots of fun games to help. (S8, ep 25)
Tim and Kai attempt to rebuild Dad's childhood spaceship.
The PAW Patrol is on an excavation dig when they unearth three fossilised eggs. Suddenly the eggs start to hatch and there are three baby pterodactyls running around.
Marathon: It's the day of the London Marathon! Peppa and family come to cheer Daddy on. Peppa and George see many runners dressed in funny costumes - and then they spot Daddy! (S8, ep 26)
Ben and Holly set out to rescue Redbeard the Elf Pirate's sunken treasure. Mr Elf steers the Elf Submarine to the bottom of the lake, but then they are gobbled up by Big Bad Barry.
Grandpa's Robot: Grandpa is building something in his shed. It is his latest pet project. It's a robot called Frank.
Paper Games: Peppa and her friends are at playgroup. Madame Gazelle is teaching the children fun games to play with paper.
King Thistle wants fish for dinner, so he goes out fishing with Mr Elf, Ben and Holly on Mr Elf's boat. Mr Elf tells them a story about the biggest, baddest fish ever - Big Bad Barry.
Clouds: Mummy, Daddy, Peppa and George are going to the seaside. Mummy and Daddy explain clouds to Peppa and George who have a little sing and dance about clouds.
Peppa and her family travel to Paris to visit Delphine and her relatives. The donkeys take Peppa and her family to the top of the Eiffel Tower, forcing Dad to face his fear of heights.
The Tooth Fairy: Ben and Holly are excited when they learn that Nanny Plum is a Tooth Fairy at night, and go along with her to pick up a little girl's tooth. But the little girl is not so little!
Bat's the Way I Like It: The bats that nest in Grandad's shed each year are missing. Can Stan and Gran encourage these nocturnal creatures to return when they can't hear them.

It is time for a day out and Peppa, George, Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig and Suzy Sheep all go to visit Tiny Land. They see tiny dinosaurs, their favourite tiny landmarks and even a tiny Miss Rabbit doing even more jobs.

It's Richard Rabbit's birthday party and George is invited. That can only mean one thing, soft play. George and friends have great fun, swinging, bouncing and climbing, but it isn't quite as much fun for the grown-ups.
Pirate Treasure: When Captain Squid leaves his treasure map in the Little Kingdom, Redbeard the Elf Pirate leads Ben, Holly and Nanny Plum on a treasure hunt.
Stan and Gran are enjoying a beach clean, but the rubbish seems to have a mind of its own! When a yoghurt pot goes walk-about, Stan spies a mystery.

Grandpa and Granny Pig show and share with Peppa and George their toys and hobbies. Granny shows her special doll from childhood and Grandpa his love of building toy planes. Peppa and George have great fun when Grandpa reveals his new biggest plane ever that even George can fit in.
Daddy Piggy arrives in an electric car. The family go out and are surprised when the car talks.

There's a pirate-themed holiday in town, but Zuma isn't in a festive mood. His revamped persona gets tested when a real pirate arrives, bent on hidden treasure and ready to destroy the town to get it.
On a rainy day, Granny Sheep plays in the garden with Peppa and Suzy. They decide to play with cardboard boxes and build a hospital, a cookie factory, and a train station.
Miss Rabbit gives Peppa and her friends a tennis lesson, but the tennis balls get everywhere. Mr Stallion and Miss Corgi arrive with strawberries and cream.
Peppa is on a play date with Candy Cat at Mr Cat's Café. Candy shows Mr Cat the drawings they've done of everyone, and he hangs them up for everyone to see.
Holly breaks her wand and must go to the Wand Factory, at the bottom of the Great Elf Tree, to get it fixed.
What Babies Do: Peppa and her family are visiting Cousin Chloe's House to play with Baby Alexander. Peppa learns babies are not like dolls at all, and do lots of things every day.
Lenses: Peppa hands Penny and Pedro the wrong glasses by mistake and they can't see very well. Madame Gazelle then tells them the importance of lenses and how they're in all sorts of things!
A cake sale is organised to mend the magic school, but Queen Thistle is baking and no one can eat her cakes.

Igloo: It's a snowy day and Peppa's family build an igloo for their snowman. They then hide away in it during the snowstorm, but Penny Polar Bear and her parents love snowstorms and Peppa's igloo too.
Party Bus: Peppa receives an invite to Candy Cat's birthday party - on a double decker bus! (S7, ep 17)
It is harvest day. The elves and fairies enlist the help of Mr Gnome in picking blackberries. If only they could stop him from eating them all.
Movie Night: Peppa and friends are at Penny Polar Bear's house for a movie night. But before they can watch it, the children need to decide where to sit, and which popcorn to eat. (S7, ep 18)
Baron Bite raids Jade's crystal caves in 'Cave Invaders', then in 'Stone Pangolin Surprise', Rammy turns into a big stone pangolin.
Art House Day: Granny Sheep and Suzy take Granny Pig and Peppa around Art House Day. After a day full of screen printing and silhouette miniatures, Granny Pig finds the perfect artwork. (S7, ep 19)
The children have adopted a new pet, a dragon named Dave. They did not know that he was going to grow and grow though and need to find him a place where he belongs.

The Slowest Race in the World: When Thomas, Kana, and Diesel 'race' to see who can go the slowest, their lack of speed provides challenges - and lets Thomas see what he might have missed. (S27, ep 17)

When Mayor Humdinger's trash-compacting truck messes up the beach, Rocky's new Re-Use It Truck comes to the rescue; when a gift of armour for the Princess gets scattered all over town, Rocky uses his Re-Use It Truck to put the armour back together.
pr.sub: Pups Save a Trash-Dinger; Pups Save the Royal Armor

pr.d: An injured bat can't remember who she is in 'The Bat Who Couldn't Remember', and then in 'The Hidden Hitchhiker', Sam and Kit get stuck together! (S2, ep 5)
Wheeler discovers an ancient shell when 'The Crew Builds An Underwater Shell Museum', and then in 'The Crew Builds A Giant Shoe Store', ducks take Wheeler on a wild ride.
Ryan Reynolds reads stories to help the world fall asleep. Tonight Ryan shares stories that are fully dressed.

Mr Curry is sure there's a monster in the park lake in 'Paddington and the Lake Monster', and in 'Paddington's Space Radio', Toq wants to let her dad know she's thinking of him up in space. (S3, ep 2)
Farmer Al's new machine goes haywire in 'Pups Stop the Garboni', then in 'Pups Save the Porcupine', the Paw Patrol catch a trouble-making sleepy porcupine and bring it back to the woods.
Pups rescue Ace and Skye from a stuck plane in 'Pups and the Ace of Skies', then in 'Pups Save the Babysitter', Priya saves the pups at the farm.
When George loses the metal wind-up key for his toy robot in the long grass, Grandpa Pig cannot find his metal detector to help George track it down.
Paddington helps Mateo dress up in 'Paddington and the Three Musketeers', then in 'Paddington and the Dinosaur Hunt', Paddington, Simi and Jonathan are on a dinosaur hunt in the park. (S3, ep 3)

Madame Gazelle takes the class through a simple tots workout at Peppa's playground that uses spinning hoops. Though they have fun playing with the hoops, they have a hard time spinning them around their waists as directed.

It is Molly Mole's first day at school and she quickly makes best friends with Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit. Molly shows them how good she is at digging while taking them on a tour of her underground house.

Mummy Sheep gets the news that she has got a new job far away, leaving Suzy and Peppa to wonder how they're going to carry on being best friends; Peppa gives Suzy some presents to remember her by, before a surprising change for Mummy Sheep changes everything.

Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George go to the skate park with their bicycles, scooters and skateboards. While Peppa has fun playing around on Daddy's skateboard, she soon learns that he is more of an expert than she realised.
Things go missing in Windsor Gardens in 'Paddington's Journey into a Black Hole', then in 'Paddington's Rainbow Race!', Simi and Paddington try to find the gold at the end of rainbow. (S3, ep 4)
Baron Bite steals a submarine from Sir Steel in 'Rise Of The Sub-Zero Sub', then in 'Balloon Bonanza', the Deer Squad's planet powers bring Trick Alien's giant balloon animals to life.
Peppa finds a small bird on the ground in the garden of her house. She takes him to Dr Hamster, who explains that it is a swift and is probably tired after a long journey.
At Chloe's birthday party, the children and grownups struggle to finish the inflatable obstacle course to reach the prize.
Peppa and her friends have fun while painting in the playgroup. Madame Gazelle then teaches them how to play games with parachutes.
Nanny Plum conjures up a hamster called Pippin for the twins.
Bigger House: With a new baby on the way, Mummy and Daddy Pig realise they have run out of space at home! They decide to make their own home bigger with an extension. (S8, ep 1)
Tim, Tommy and Tia bird-sit the Bronte's MoonParrot.
The Big Build: Mr Bull arrives with his team to start work on Peppa's house renovation. Peppa and family move into the caravan in the garden while the work is being completed. (S8, ep 2)
Tim does all he can to get the new DinoStar toy.
Ben, Holly and Gaston the Ladybird find a large egg in the meadow. A tiny chick hatches from the egg and the children must find the mummy bird.

Decorating: With the building work done, it's time to decorate! Peppa and George have fun choosing how to decorate their attic bedrooms. It's dinosaurs for George, but what will Peppa pick? (S8, ep 3)
New Car: Mr Zebra arrives with a new car seat for the baby! Excited to try it in the car, the family soon realise it won't fit with Peppa and George too. It's time for a new car! (S8, ep 4)
Tim has a clear out of all his old stuff but soon finds not all of it is destined for the rubbish tip.
The engines are excited to see the Northern Lights with Harold the Helicopter.
Jigsaw Festival: Granny and Grandpa Pig are taking Peppa and George to a festival - a jigsaw festival! Peppa is amazed by all of the completed jigsaws around the festival. (S8, ep 5)
A Fairy Fly is coming to stay in the Fairy Tail Garden! But before they arrive, the Gabby Cats have to show they are true friends by being kind, helpful and welcoming.
Hobbies: Madame Gazelle is making a wicker basket. She explains it is a hobby - something you do to relax. The children discuss hobbies and learn about each other's favourite things to do. (S8, ep 6)
Bruno and Thomas must step outside their comfort zones to find Bruno's prized map, which gets swept away by the wind.
Patchwork Quilt: Mummy Pig and Peppa are at Granny Pig's house. They find Mummy's old patchwork quilt that Granny made for her as a baby. Peppa decides she'd like to make one for the baby! (S8, ep 7)
Granny Sheep's Art Van: Peppa is out with Suzy and Granny Sheep. They come across an old van that Miss Rabbit is recycling. Granny Sheep decides she would like to turn it into an art van. (S8, ep 8)

Dora and Boots transform into mermaids for an all-new underwater mission of the Mermaid Kingdom. Mermaid Dora and her companion, Boots the mer-monkey, help a lost pink dolphin find a magic jewel it needs.
Pups Save a Cat Burglar: It's Pie Swap Day! Humdinger sends Rocky Kitty to take one of Mr. Porter's tasty pies, so he can join the contest. [SL]
Gabby unboxes some crayons and a colouring book with the same doodle on every page. But when CatRat gets stuck inside the book, Gabby and Pandy must go on a doodle rescue.
Pups Save a Bookmobile: When Ms. Marjorie brings her bookmobile to Everest and the kids of the mountains, Maynard accidentally sets the van rolling and goes off on a wild ride. [SL]
Join Tim Rex as he tackles kid-shaped problems with dino-sized solutions in space! Tia's new balloon gets stuck in a tree, so Tim tries to get it down.
A superfood cake creates some super heroes in 'Paddington's Hero Squad', then in 'Paddington's Knightly Quest', Paddington wants to become a Knight; but needs to complete heroic quests! (S3, ep 13)
Farmer's snails go on strike in 'The Snail Whisperer', and then in 'Smurfs Might Fly', The Smurfs prepare for their sarsaparilla banquet, unaware that Gargamel has enchanted the thicket.
Tim, Tia and Tommy try to convince Mum and Dad to let them have a pet.
Join Tim Rex as he tackles kid-shaped problems with dino-sized solutions in space! Tim and Kai go crater surfing and attempt a cool new trick.
Paddington and Simi go on a magical journey into the human body.

Grandpa Pig is taking Peppa and George for a day on his boat. They meet Mr Bull who is using his digger boat to remove all the rubbish in the river that shouldn't be there.

Peppa and her friends are at the clubhouse. They are playing at serving takeaway food. The children assign themselves different roles, including a cook and a waiter. Once the imaginary food is ready, they have fun delivering it.
Peppa and George play with walkie-talkies at Granny and Grandpa Pig's house. Grandpa Pig teaches Peppa and George how to use codenames to talk using the gadgets.
While celebrating Friendship Day, the pups spring into action to stop Mayor Humdinger from ruining Adventure Bay's reputation as the friendliest town on the map.
Moon Cow: Tim, Tommy & Tia find a lost toy and vow to return it to its owner. (S1, ep 16)
Peppa is intrigued to see her parents go to work every day. Daddy Pig makes Peppa her very own office to make her feel good.
Tailball: Tim, Tommy and Tia take on their parents at Tailball. (S1, ep 15)
Peppa finds a small bird on the ground in the garden of her house. She takes him to Dr Hamster, who explains that it is a swift and is probably tired after a long journey.

Peppa and her family are visiting Cousin Chloe's house to play with Baby Alexander. Peppa thinks she knows all about babies because she already looks after her doll, and George is a baby too, though he disagrees.
Spaceship: Tim and Kai attempt to rebuild Dad's childhood spaceship. (S1, ep 5)

At the playground, Pedro and Penny's glasses fall off; both think that their glasses are broken, as they cannot see very well; Madame Gazelle shows Pedro and Penny different types of objects with lenses.
The Elf Submarine: Ben and Holly set out to rescue Redbeard the Elf Pirate's sunken treasure. Mr Elf steers the Elf Submarine to the bottom of the lake, but then they are gobbled up by Big Bad Barry!
The Paw Patrol is on an excavation dig when they unearth three fossilized eggs. Soon the eggs start to hatch, and three baby pterodactyls are running around.
It's a snowy day and Peppa's family build an igloo for their snowman. They hide in it during a snowstorm, but Penny Polar Bear and her parents love snowstorms and also Peppa's igloo.

Peppa and her friends are at playgroup when they learn that Mr. Bull and Mrs. Cow are getting married the next day; everyone goes into a panic when they confess how they have done nothing to prepare for the big day.
Big Bad Barry: King Thistle wants fish for dinner, so he goes out fishing with Mr Elf, Ben and Holly on Mr Elf's boat. Mr Elf tells them a story about the biggest, baddest fish ever - Big Bad Barry.

Everyone prepares for Mr. Bull and Mrs. Cow's wedding; Peppa and the soon-to-be-weds go to the jewellers to get rings, to the dressmakers, to get a wedding dress and finally to Peppa's house to sort the wedding cake.
Holly spends the day with King Thistle on his royal duties. King Thistle must launch an elf boat, judge a fairy fruit competition and make a speech at the festival.
Bat's the Way I Like It: The bats that nest in Grandad's shed each year are missing. Can Stan and Gran encourage these nocturnal creatures to return when they can't hear them? (Ep9)
Peppa and family go on an exciting trip to Paris to see the sights and meet Delphine Donkey and her family.
It's time for a day out and Peppa, George, Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig and Suzy Sheep all go to visit Tiny Land.
The children are at the Elf Farm, but to learn where milk comes from they must visit a big farm, to find cows. The children travel to Lucy Big's farm, where she shows them all the animals.
Runaway Rubbish: Stan and Gran are enjoying a beach clean, but the rubbish seems to have a mind of its own! When a yoghurt pot goes walk-about, Stan spies a mystery! (Ep10)
It's Richard Rabbit's birthday party and George is invited, and that can only mean one thing; Soft Play.
Grandpa Pig shares with Peppa and George his love of building toy planes and there is one extra special plane that Granny Pig has yet to see.
Peppa looks after Madame Gazelle's guinea pigs Ginger and Brian while she goes on holiday, but they prove to be more trouble for Mummy and Daddy Pig than they think.
Peppa and her friends are in a playgroup and Mr Bull is building a wind turbine. Madame Gazelle explains everything to the children about wind energy.
Mummy Pig suggests the family all make pizzas together, so everyone prepares and chooses the food to make their own individual pizzas.
Peppa and her family hire a canoe from Miss Rabbit. They imagine they are in a jungle and then unexpectedly bump into Mrs Crocodile. Later on, Mr Lion invites them to have a picnic.
There's a new friend for Peppa at her playgroup, Lotte Lama. She can speak a foreign language, and Peppa loves talking. Everyone loves talking.
Peppa is excited to help George explore the world of sounds now he has his hearing aid. She shows him her favourite sounds including the splashing of jumping in a muddy puddle!
Peppa, her friends, and their parents, learn woodworking from Mister Wolf. He asks Daddy Pig to make a hut out of twigs, but it isn't very strong, and Mister Wolf manages to blow it down.
Mummy and Daddy Pig get stuck behind Mrs Badger's tractor on the way to her farm, where Peppa and George learn about how useful tractors can be, even if they aren't very fast.
Grampy Rabbit teaches Danny Dog and Peppa why his lifeboat is so important when it comes to saving lives at sea and gives them tips on how to stay safe.
Pedro loves superheroes. He has a superhero party and Super Potato is one of the guests. Together, they play some party games and Super Potato gets to show everyone his superpowers.
At the playgroup, Madame Gazelle is reading the children a story, but a page is missing so she makes up an ending. During playtime, the children make up their own alternative endings.

Peppa and friends are at Penny Polar Bear's house for a movie night; before they can watch it, the children need to decide where to sit, which popcorn to eat and take a toilet break -- then they're finally ready.
Peppa and her friends are playing in their clubhouse, which has a fold-down counter at the front. The children pretend to run a little shop for the parents to buy things from.

Peppa and her friends come to school early to have breakfast together. They learn about how food gives you energy and talk about their favourite breakfast foods. They all end up having toast with fun toppings. Finally, they have a good stretch and dance to get ready for the day and all sing the breakfast song.
Police Officer Panda and Police Officer Squirrel visit Peppa's playgroup. They offer two lucky children the chance to spend the day with them.
Miss Rabbit is teaching the children a swimming lesson, They start out by swimming with floats tucked under their arms.
Features the grown-up's singing competition where the kids are the judges.
It's the day of the duck race! When Miss Rabbit gives the sign, everyone drops their ducks in the river at the first bridge - whose will make it to the second bridge first?

Peppa and her family oversee the building of a large remodel to their home to accommodate the new baby, but things go awry when Daddy Pig's blueprints get swapped for George's plans for a robot house.

Peppa and her friends are at playgroup and today Madame Gazelle would like them all to play music. They think they are playing with normal instruments, but today the children must make their own instruments. Madame Gazelle gathers bits and bobs of old packaging and shows them how to make their own. At the end of the day, they put on a special concert for the parents.
George and Peppa spend the day playing golf with Grandpa Pig, but they are much more interested in the colourful mini-golf course next door.
On a day out with her family, Peppa is encouraged to find words to describe the different kinds of puddles they find.
Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit pretend to be babies to get Mummy Rabbit's attention. Mummy Rabbit plays along until they admit they are not really babies!

Dr Hamster has brought a giant ant farm and opens the ant farm's lid to show how they got in. Nobody noticed they escaped and starting moving things in the classroom! The children place food around to lead the ants safely back.
Peppa is playing at Suzy's house, and they find out that Granny Sheep is moving in. She transforms the dull spare room and attic into an exotic boudoir and creative studio for her to make things.

It is raining, and Grandpa Rabbit has built a rocket pack. As he demonstrates it to Peppa and George, he inadvertently ends up atop a snowy mountain. Miss Hare attempts to rescue him but becomes stranded on the mountaintop as well.
Mummy, Daddy, Peppa and George go to the park. Peppa and George play on the hopping logs, the bouncing branch and the monkey bars.
When Daddy Pig is given a parking ticket, Peppa and George learn that adults have rules just like children - and that they get told off too.
When Peppa decides to walk up the big hill during their family hike in the countryside, Daddy Pig assures her that the hard climb will be worth it.
After seeing an advert for the London Marathon, Daddy Pig applies to take part to show the kids what grit and determination really looks like!
Madame Gazelle is making a wicker basket. She explains it is her hobby - something you do to relax. The children discuss hobbies and learn about each other's favourite things to do.
With the building work complete, it's time to decorate! Peppa and George have fun choosing how to decorate their new attic bedrooms. It's dinosaurs for George, but what will Peppa pick?

Peppa and George's toy basket is full, and their beds are covered in toys, so Mummy Pig decides it is time to order a new toy cupboard. The cupboard arrives in the post, but it needs to be assembled - and Mummy and Daddy Pig are not very good at DIY. Luckily help is at hand, as Mr Zebra the Postman loves assembling flat-pack furniture.
Granny and Grandpa's pet Polly Parrot comes to stay, and Peppa and George love Polly Parrot. But when she flies away, no one knows what to do.
Grandpa Pig has built a fantastic little train called Gertrude, and when they take a ride, they give all their friends a ride.
When Peppa goes for a sleepover at Zoe Zebra's house with Suzy Sheep, Rebecca Rabbit, Candy Cat and Emily Elephant, the girls are too excited to go to sleep.
It's nighttime at Grandpa and Granny Pig's house, and Peppa and George have stayed up late to help hunt for slugs and snails. But what other night animals will they find?
Peppa and George make everyone laugh when they dress up as Mummy and Daddy Pig.
When Daddy Pig loses his glasses he gets a bit grumpy, but Peppa and George have lots of fun looking for them.
Madame Gazelle takes Peppa and her friends on a train ride where they must tick off what they see on their activity sheets.
Peppa and family go on a walk through the forest where they meet all of their favourite fairytale characters. They visit the home of bears who like porridge and meet a hungry Mr Wolf.
Peppa and all her friends at playgroup dress up as different countries from all over the world.
Peppa and George are playing in Grandpa Pig's garden when they find a little snail.
Peppa and Suzy Sheep are best friends, but one day they have a quarrel over a game of cards and decide they are not best friends any more.
When the school roof is broken and needs fixing, Peppa volunteers Mummy Pig to do a parachute jump to raise money. Daddy Pig goes up too, and has to overcome his fear of heights.

Mummy Pig's book is finished, and it's time to show it off to Peppa and her playgroup friends. Unfortunately, Peppa and George lose some of the book when they are playing, and Mummy Pig has to think quickly to fix it.
Peppa and George love going to the beach on sunny days. They bring their water wings, a beach ball and buckets and spades. Peppa and George have fun burying Daddy Pig in the sand.
Peppa and George go on a boat trip with Grandpa Pig, but they must send Polly Parrot for help when their boat runs aground. Polly fetches Granny Pig and Grandad Dog to rescue them.
Peppa and George visit a restaurant for the first time to celebrate Grandpa's birthday. They have a great time asking for everything they would expect at a party.
It is bedtime and Peppa calls Kylie Kangaroo and is surprised to learn that it is not morning or winter where she is! Daddy Pig explains this using a big ball to represent the Earth.
Peppa and family help make a garden on the roof of the flats. Mr Bull assists with a big truck and crane. There is even a little something for Mrs Duck.
The nurse visits and decides to focus on teaching proper baby-holding techniques. She demonstrates a safe method for a small person, like Peppa, to hold an infant correctly.
The playgroup is visiting the zoo today. Mr Lion then shows them a giant lizard. The children all believe it's a dinosaur. Mr Lion says if he did have a dinosaur, he would keep that a secret.
Peppa and her family have a day out at the seaside, and build a very large sandcastle with all their friends.

Peppa and George go bird watching with Grandpa Pig. Peppa quacks like a duck, George coos like a pigeon, and they all have great fun filling in Grandpa Pig's book. Grandpa wants to see a cuckoo, and suddenly he hears one calling.
Peppa and her family go to the water park for an adventure, and Miss Rabbit is in charge. There are lots of fun things to do at the water park, but the first thing to do is to put on a swimsuit.

pr.d: Sandy only wanted to spend a relaxing holiday alone on the moon. But it seems she's got a stowaway aboard her rocket who doesn't share her idea. On his trip to the Ocean Mint, Mr Krabs learns that old money is shredded and burned.
pr.sub: Mooncation; Mr. Krabs Takes a Vacation

pr.d: Narlene and Nobby teach Regigilled about backwoods living in 'Regi-Hilled', then in 'The Perfect Camper', the Trawler cabin creates the perfect camper to compete in the Camp Summer Games.
Sandy tries to study SpongeBob and Patrick's behaviour, but her science experiment goes horribly awry. Mr. Krabs takes Plankton's advice, and finally marries the only thing he ever loved, money.
It's the annual foam-fisted all-camp karate battle in 'Hill Fu', then in 'Sun's Out, Fun's Out', It's the hottest day of summer, but there's only one AC in the whole camp.
Counsellor Squidward is determined for his cabin to win the annual camp art competition. The Kamp Koral campers befriend a cute cow with a big appetite.
Squidward is determined for his cabin to win the annual camp art competition in 'Painting with Squidward', then in 'Kamp Kow', The Kamp Koral campers befriend a cow with a big appetite.
Patrick and Octo must survive together in the forest after Octo twists all of his ankles. The adults sneak off to play a board game, but one of the campers is not easily shaken off.
Squidward takes a new job as Manager of Weenie Hut Jr's in 'Wiener Takes All', then in 'Stuck in an Elevator', Squidward gets trapped on his way to return a nearly overdue library book.
The Patricks battle for control of the TV; Upturn moves in with the Stars.
Patrick learns what GrandPat's childhood was like; Cave Pat hosts a show with his cave family.
pr.sub: The Lil' Patscals; The Pre-Historic Patrick Star Show

pr.d: SpongeBob embarks on an epic journey to have his beloved spatula reforged by the legendary Guru Greasetrap; SpongeBob builds a snail-house outside for Gary to play in while he is at work.
pr.sub: Spatula of the Heavens; Gary's Playhouse

pr.d: SpongeBob and Patrick make it their mission to reunite the recently fired robot band from Goofy Goober's; Patrick is sent to the pound for acting like a worm, but he won't be able to leave unless SpongeBob can train him.
Tinkle, Ouchie, and Pinkeye must venture back home together in 'The Uncredible Journey', then in 'Host-a-Palooza', Patrick gets injured, so his family members take turns hosting the show.
After getting rid of Ouchie, Pinkeye takes over the Star house; Patrick and Squidina must find safety during the dad joke apocalypse.
pr.sub: Get Ouch; Day of the Living Dad Jokes

pr.d: Squidward and SpongeBob go on strike from the Krusty Krab in 'Squid On Strike', while in 'Sandy, SpongeBob, And The Worm', a large worm is terrorising Bikini Bottom.
Patrick and Squidina report the news around Bikini Bottom; "The Patrick Show!" presents the epic conclusion to the first half of its first season.
Mr Krabs' mother is dating again, and worse still the object of her desires is Plankton, in 'Enemy In Law'. Then in 'Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy VI', the ancient super-heroes take to the big screen.
Patrick learns how to exercise. A family of dummies move into the Star home.
Krabs puts Squidward in charge of all camp complaints in 'Who's Complaining?', then in 'Patrick's Star', Patrick receives a star on his birthday.
SpongeBob and Squidward are sent to collect unpaid bills. SpongeBob and Squidward cook a fancy meal for Mrs Puff.
Plankton recruits Sandy to help in his lab in 'Mad Science Squirrel', then in 'To Pop a Bubble', SpongeBob's new friend proves unpopular at camp.

When Patrick discovers the pineapple's library, SpongeBob introduces him to the wonderful world of book learning. Plankton hasn't tried to steal the secret formula in a while and that's making Mr Krabs nervous.
SpongeBob gets a pair of long pants, but they change his life in unexpected ways. When Larry the Lobster opens a new gym in Bikini Bottom, SpongeBob becomes his best customer.

SpongeBob and Patrick bet who can hold a funny face the longest, then their faces freeze that way. SpongeBob and Patrick spend one last glorious, and dangerous, day at Glove World before it closes for good.
In Hamdonia, Prince Shmeat and Tofu Todd embark on a quest to defeat the Maw in 'Braggin' Slayer', and in 'Scaredy Pat', after learning what stage fright is, Patrick fears his own audience.

Plankton has demolished the Chum Bucket and in its place, he has built a Roman coliseum. The Bikini Bottom Symphony is accepting submissions for their composition contest, and Squidward is determined to win.
The Star Family is a team of superheroes in 'Super Stars', and then in 'Now Museum, Now You Don't', Cecil works security at Lady Upturn's art museum.

After arriving one minute late for work, SpongeBob decides to move into the Krusty Krab so that he will never be late again. When Plankton secretly turns down the thermostat at the Krusty Krab, the entire restaurant freezes over.
pr.sub: New Digs; Krabs a la Mode

Liz gibt DCI Wheatley wichtige Informationen, verschweigt jedoch bestimmte Fakten, da sie befürchtet, sich selbst und ihre geheimen Ermittlungen zu der undichten Stelle zu gefährden.

In Folge 3 gerät die einzige überlebende Zeugin, die Tochter der ermordeten McLennans, in große Gefahr. Kaum jemand wusste, wo sie sich aufhält - Liz Nyles beginnt zu vermuten, dass es eine oder sogar mehrere undichte Stellen gibt.

In Folge 4 wird Liz Nyles mit dem problematischen neuen Zeugen Patrick Ellis konfrontiert, den sie gegen ihr Bauchgefühl in das Zeugenschutzprogramm aufnehmen soll. Das bringt sie in Kontakt mit dem stellvertretenden Polizeichef.
Liz wird immer klarer, dass sie machtvolle Feinde innerhalb der Polizei hat, die alles tun werden, um ihre eigenen Spuren zu verwischen und ihr alles in die Schuhe zu schieben.

In der letzten Folge wird Crowther tot in seiner Zelle aufgefunden. Liz glaubt nicht an einen Selbstmord. Ihr wird plötzlich klar, dass die Verschwörung nicht von Crowther orchestriert wurde, sondern noch größere Dimensionen hat.

pr.t: Grantchester - Ermittler im Auftrag des Herrn
pr.d: Ein scheinbar einfacher Fall entwickelt sich zu einem komplexen Geflecht aus Täuschung und internationaler Intrige: Zwei Männer werden vergiftet, einer von ihnen stirbt - doch schnell stellt sich die Frage.

Will wird nach einem Unfall von Polizist Mac gerettet. Geordie und Will geraten in einen Mordfall an einem Bauernpaar, bei dem Verwandte verdächtig sind. Will wird entführt und entdeckt die Wahrheit. Leonard wird von Elliot schikaniert.

Markus Gellert vertritt den Rapper Dogan Özdil, den eine internationale Plattenfirma unter Vertrag nehmen will. Nur ist Dogan noch bei Murat Sahin unter Vertrag. Dogan behauptet, Murat habe seine Karriere nicht befördert.

Die 15-jährige Milena Rönert will, dass ihrer Mutter Annelie das Sorgerecht entzogen wird. Der Grund: Eine internationale Modelagentur hat Milena einen Vertrag angeboten. Für Milena würde damit ihr Traum von einer Modelkarriere wahr werden.

Julia Klug kehrt zurück nach Berlin. Gezwungenermaßen. Hoch verschuldet, weil einem Betrüger auf den Leim gegangen, muss sie mit Baby Ellie wieder bei ihren nichtsahnenden Eltern unterschlüpfen, zurück nach Hause, von wo sie vor 13 Jahren regelrecht geflohen war. Es kommt für Julia noch schlimmer: Die SEK-erfahrene Elitepolizistin muss ab jetzt ausgerechnet im Betrugsdezernat der Polizeidirektion 7 arbeiten.

Die verzweifelte Claudia Prinz will sich in die Spree stürzen. Sie ist auf einen Heiratsschwindler hereingefallen, der sie nicht nur betrogen, sondern obendrein um 10.000 Euro erleichtert hat. Für Julia Klug, die ja selber Opfer eines Heiratsschwindlers wurde, ist klar: Dieser Betrüger - er nennt sich Costa Schettino - muss zur Strecke gebracht werden! Ihr Chef Johannes Sonntag sieht das ganz anders: So ein Fall gehört in einen Groschenroman - nicht in die Zuständigkeit des Betrugsdezernats.

Halbnackt erscheint der aus dem Krankenhaus entflohene Herzpatient Norbert Brenner auf der Wache. Er will einen Diebstahl anzeigen: Sein Herz wurde geklaut! Deshalb will er auch gleich noch einen Mord anzeigen - den Mord an ihm. Marianne übergibt den seltsamen Fall an Julia. Ihr erzählt Brenner seine unglaubliche Geschichte: Wenige Minuten vor der Operation wurde die für ihn lebenswichtige Herztransplantation unter fadenscheinigen Gründen abgesagt.

Direktionschefin Marei Schiller wird wegen sexueller Belästigung vom Dienst suspendiert. Ihr wird vorgeworfen, dem Unternehmer Christian Raabe - einem der großzügigsten Wohltäter der Stadt - in den Schritt gefasst zu haben. Dabei hat sie sich nur gegen dessen plumpe Annäherungsversuche gewehrt. Aber wer glaubt der Chefin der Polizeidirektion 7, wenn Raabe die Situation ganz anders darstellt?

Der Fernsehstar Jeanette Biedermann wird von der aufgebrachten Besitzerin eines Schreibwarenladens Frau Krutsch auf offener Straße beschuldigt, sie um 150 Euro geprellt zu haben! Frau Krutsch ist verdammt sauer auf Jeanette: Sie wirft ihr vor, einen Schulranzen und diverse Schreibutensilien gekauft, aber die Rechnung dafür niemals bezahlt zu haben. Offensichtlich sind die großen Stars sich zu fein, ihre Schulden zu bezahlen! Die Begegnung mit dem Idol hatte sich Patrick Klug anders vorgestellt.

Die Norddeutsche Svea heiratet ihren Mann Peter, der aus einem Alpendorf stammt. Dort wartet ihr Schwiegervater Joseph Pirnegger bereits auf die Gelegenheit, seinen verlorenen Sohn endlich wieder nach Hause zu locken.

Svea Classen nimmt den Kampf gegen die Machenschaften ihres Schwiegervaters auf: Als frisch gekürte Bürgermeisterin der Gemeinde Klamm kämpft die Hanseatin für die Interessen der betrogenen Bergbauern. Sie entwickelt ein Konzept für den Naturpark.

Der Sturm ist das große Gesprächsthema. Im Hotel bricht Panik aus, als niemand weiß, wie man den Tresor öffnet, und der Lebensmittelhändler bezahlt werden will. Als Frau Andersen aus dem Krankenhaus zurückkehrt, liest sie einen beunruhigenden Brief.

Nach den tragischen Ereignissen greift Fie Molly Andersen unter die Arme. Morten und Amandas Vater geraten aneinander. Einige Herren wollen das Hotel wechseln, ihre Frauen jedoch sind dagegen. Der Graf trifft sich mit seinem mysteriösen Anrufer.

Der Sommer neigt sich dem Ende zu. Sie wird angeboten, über den Winter zu bleiben, doch sie zögert. Olga sucht noch immer nach einer Frau für ihren Sohn. Sibylle mag ihn sehr, hat aber Skrupel. Derweil erhält der Graf einen neuen Erpressungsbrief.

Amanda Madsen und die anderen Stammgäste aus Kopenhagen sind zurück in Andersens Strandhotel und die nächste Sommersaison ist eröffnet. Doch was ist aus Morten geworden, der unter Mordverdacht von der Polizei geflohen ist?

Amandas Vater versucht, sie zur Heirat mit Ditmar zu zwingen. Im Gegenzug würde er Morten bei der Polizei entlasten. Jedoch hat Amandas kleine Schwester ebenfalls ein Wörtchen mitzureden. Auch Max ist alles andere als begeistert von der Hochzeit.

Die in England geborene Joan Stanley (Judi Dench) studiert in Cambridge Physik und verliebt sich auf dem Campus in den ebenso attraktiven wie manipulativen Leo Galich (Tom Hughes). Durch ihn beginnt Joan das Leben durch einen ganz neuen Blickwinkel zu sehen. Sie wird zu einer Sympathisantin der sowjetischen und kommunistischen Partei und viele Jahre später, während des Zweiten Weltkriegs, als Beamtin der britischen Regierung für ein geheimes Nuklear-Forschungsprojekt angestellt. Dabei erkennt.

Selbst im Nachtzug kann Miss Marple dem Verbrechen nicht entkommen. Sie beobachtet einen brutalen Mord in einem vorbeifahrenden Zug. Die Polizei findet jedoch keine Leiche und hält die Dame für verrückt. Das lässt Miss Marple nicht auf sich sitzen.

Sie begannen mit einem aufsehenerregenden Skandal, machten ihre Liebe, die gegenseitige Anziehung, ihren Streit, den Reichtum und ihre Süchte öffentlich und wurden so zum Glamourpaar der Swinging Sixties: Elizabeth Taylor und Richard Burton. Sie ist seit ihrer Kindheit ein verwöhnter Hollywoodstar, er ist ein walisischer Bergarbeitersohn, der sich zu einem der großen Theatermimen seines Landes entwickelt hatte. Sie begegnen sich am Filmset in Rom.

Am 6. Mai 1974, vor 50 Jahren, trat Willy Brandt zurück. Der Kanzler stürzte über die Guillaume-Affäre. Sein Referent Günter Guillaume war als DDR-Spion enttarnt worden. Ein gefundenes Fressen für die Presse und die Parteifreunde.

pr.t: Adolf Kanter - Der Spion, der zu viel wusste
pr.d: Hinter dem in den 80ern als "Flick-Affäre" bekanntgewordenen Schmiergeldskandal verbirgt sich tatsächlich ein deutsch-deutscher Spionagekrimi, der den frisch gewählten Kanzler Helmut Kohl die Karriere hätte kosten können.

pr.t: Wie James Bond begann - Ian Flemming & 007 im Krieg
pr.d: Die Dokumentation zeigt, inwiefern Episoden aus den Geschichten um den Geheimagenten James Bond auf wahren Begebenheiten aus der Spionage im Zweiten Weltkrieg beruhen. Bond-Autor Ian Fleming arbeitete im Krieg für den britischen Secret Service.

Spione wie Werner Mauss, Mata Hari und Kim Philby führen gefährliche Doppelleben zwischen Intrigen, Verrat und Idealen. "Terra X History" beleuchtet die wahren Geschichten hinter den Legenden - spannender als jeder Agentenfilm.

Fast 130.000 alliierte Soldaten stürmten am 6. Juni 1944 die Strände der Normandie. Ziel war die Befreiung Frankreichs von den Nazis. Britische Doppelagenten des MI-5 verfolgten die Mission, die Deutschen von der Normandie fernzuhalten.

Am 10. Juli 1943 landen alliierte Truppen auf Sizilien. Dieser Coup ist das Ergebnis einer falschen Fährte, die die Alliierten mit einem vermeintlich vertrauten Dokument in der Tasche eines toten britischen Soldaten in Spanien gelegt hatten.

Während der Kubakrise im Oktober 1962 hatte die ganze Welt Angst vor einem Atomkrieg. Ein Spion half US-Präsident Kennedy dabei, sich gegen Chruschtschow zu behaupten. Der sowjetische Offizier Oleg Penkovsky leistete hervorragende Arbeit für die CIA.

Vier Jahre nach dem Abwurf der ersten Atombombe durch die USA zündeten im Jahre 1949 auch die Sowjets eine. Das hatte so früh niemand erwartet. Doch die Sowjets hatten während des Kalten Krieges das größte Spionagenetzwerk des Jahrhunderts aufgebaut.

Peru ist ein Land dramatischer Gegensätze: Obwohl tropische Regenwälder mehr als die Hälfte des Landes ausmachen, erstrecken sich im westlichen Teil im Schatten der Andenkette gewaltige Wüsten mit einer einzigartigen Tierwelt.

Die Reise geht in den Südosten Perus, wo sich die Region Madre de Dios erstreckt, die nach dem gleichnamigen Fluss benannt ist. Der tropische Regenwald beherbergt eine riesige, auf der Welt einzigartige Vielfalt an Pflanzen- und Tierarten.

Informiert wird ausführlich über das politische und gesellschaftliche Geschehen in Deutschland, Europa und der Welt. Neben den Übertragungen wichtiger politischer Ereignisse werden in Gesprächen mit Experten aktuelle Debatten analysiert.

Schnabeltiere, Dingos oder Tasmanische Teufel - in Australiens weiten Wäldern leben Tiere, die es nur dort gibt, nirgendwo sonst. Ihre außergewöhnliche Anpassungsfähigkeit ermöglicht ihnen ein Überleben in dieser oftmals feindlichen Natur.

Aktuelle gesellschaftliche, politische und wirtschaftliche Themen stehen im Mittelpunkt einer vertiefenden Betrachtung. Durch sachliche Reportagen, fundierte Hintergrundberichte und Analysen werden relevante Ereignisse umfassend beleuchtet.

pr.t: Die spinnen, die Deutschen! Comedy von Loriot & Co.
pr.d: Humorlos, penibel, effizient und am liebsten in Funktionsjacken: Klischees über Deutsche sind nicht sexy, aber dafür schön lustig. Ob Loriots deutsche Prototypen oder Phil Laudes "Alman", sie bringen die Deutschen zum Lachen und zum Nachdenken.

Es geht um das Wichtigste aus Politik, Wirtschaft, Kultur, Sport und Wissenschaft. Korrespondenten der ARD sorgen für schnelle und präzise News. Die Tagesschau-Ausgaben zur vollen Stunde werden teilweise mit Videotext-Untertiteln ausgestrahlt.

Tierfilmer Rainer Bergomaz und sein indianischer Kollege Yung Sandy begeben sich auf eine Expedition in eines der letzten unerschlossenen Gebiete der Erde, um den Mohrenkaiman zu finden. Bisher weiß man kaum etwas über den großen Bruder des Alligators und das größte Krokodil Südamerikas. Wie alle großen Echsen wurde auch der Mohrenkaiman über Jahrhunderte hinweg erbarmungslos gejagt. So ist seine Art inzwischen stark gefährdet.

Rainer Bergomaz und Yung Sandy überwinden Stromschnellen, Flüsse und Wasserfälle, klettern auf 50 Meter hohe Bäume, kämpfen sich durch Buschwerk und Lianen, um ein Harpyien-Nest zu finden. Harpyien zählen zu den mächtigsten Greifvögeln der Welt. Die seltenen Adler leben in den Regenwäldern Südamerikas. Der Griff ihrer Klauen ist kräftiger als der Biss eines Schäferhundes, ihre Krallen sind länger als die des Grizzlybären.

Weltweit hören wir derzeit vor allem negative Schlagzeilen rund um Urwald-Abholzung und Umwelt-Zerstörung. Doch es gibt auch Hoffnung. Im Norden Argentiniens werden die ersten Jaguare eines besonderen Schutzprojekts ausgewildert.

Ihr ganzes Leben lang kommen weibliche Meeresschildkröten genau zu dem Strand zurück, an dem sie selbst aus dem Ei geschlüpft sind, um ihre eigenen Eier abzulegen. Wenn es den Strand noch gibt, denn immer mehr Strände nutzt der Mensch.

Verschiedene Themen der deutschen und internationalen Zeit- und Kulturgeschichte werden nachgezeichnet. Mit Expertengesprächen und szenischen Nacherzählungen werden dabei Vorkommnisse aus jüngerer und älterer Geschichte neu zum Leben erweckt.

pr.t: Tolkien. Die wahre Geschichte der Ringe
pr.d: Die Folge erweckt die Inspirationen hinter J.R.R. Tolkiens populärer Fantasy-Welt Mittelerde zum Leben. Die große Popularität von Tolkiens Universum ist zeitlos und weltweit verbreitet. Generationen von Lesern sind davon geprägt worden.

pr.t: Tolkien. Die wahre Geschichte der Ringe
pr.d: Lange ging man davon aus, dass Tolkiens Werk in erster Linie Fantasy sei. Jüngere Forschungen zeigen, wie stark die Weltgeschichte in Mittelerde eingeflossen ist. Vor allem Tolkiens Teilnahme am Ersten Weltkrieg hat zahlreiche Spuren hinterlassen.

Fred and Rose West raped, tortured and murdered at least a dozen young British girls between 1967 and 1987, including several of their own daughters. Learn how two of Britain's most notorious serial killers were able to get away with their crimes for so long, how they hid the victim's remains within the confines of their own home, and how they were eventually taken down.
Documentary series examining what led Fred and Rose West to become serial killers.

pr.t: Fred and Rose: The West Murders
pr.d: Focuses on the notorious house which the couple shared in Gloucester. Fred and Rose murdered their first three victims - Anna McFall, Charmaine West and then Rena Costello - because they 'got in the way'. But when they moved into 25 Cromwell Street, the couple began to kill for sexual thrills.

pr.t: Fred and Rose: The West Murders
pr.d: Looks at how a dogged police officer, Hazel Savage, fought to have the Wests' patio excavated when she became suspicious about the whereabouts of their daughter. The film also includes insights from both Fred and Rose West's former solicitors.
In Norfolk, an otherwise unassuming summer evening is shaken by an armed robbery. A vehicle is stolen, and innocent people are shot.

Detective Inspector Burgess of Norwich CID has a problem as the number of home burglaries has rocketed. Looking at the evidence, officers suspect that one man is potentially responsible for a large part of the spike in residential crime.

pr.t: Wayne Couzens: Killer in Plain Sight
pr.d: Using interviews with expert witnesses, detectives and members of law enforcement, it reveals the true story of Wayne Couzens, asks how he was able to hide from scrutiny for so long, and considers the larger problem of misogyny in the police force.

pr.t: Verpfuscht - Ein Fall für die Beauty-Docs
pr.d: Ein Mann mit Superhelden-Armen aus Silikon wird deswegen von seiner Freundin verlassen. Eine Frau möchte ihre riesige Nase korrigieren lassen und damit ihr Liebesleben in Gang bringen. Eine andere Frau will eine Bauchstraffung rückgängig machen.

Mary will dabei helfen, das Chaos in der Küche auf ein Minimum zu reduzieren und hat dafür einen Tipp. Am besten, man bereitet alles in nur einer Pfanne zu. Mary hat vier Rezeptideen, mit denen das ganz einfach möglich ist.

Mary widmet sich der französischen Küche, die für sie immer etwas ganz Besonderes ist. Sie startet mit dem Käsesandwich "Croque Madame" und geht dann zu einer Zwiebelsuppe und einem Rib-Eye-Steak über. Sie rundet alles mit einem Omelette-Soufflé ab.

Gute Vorbereitung ist in der Küche das A und O. Besonders für Menschen, die wenig Zeit haben. Viele Gerichte können am Wochenende vorgekocht werden. Mary zeigt einige Rezepte, um Abwechslung in die gesunde Ernährung zu bringen.

Häufig bleiben nach dem Essen Reste übrig, die dann viel zu oft den Weg in den Mülleimer finden. Das muss jedoch nicht sein. Denn aus Resten lassen sich wieder leckere Gerichte zubereiten. Mary zeigt dies an leckeren Beispielen.

pr.t: Hochzeit auf den ersten Blick - Australien
pr.d: Die ersten zwei Paare müssen entscheiden, ob sie ihre Ehe auch im richtigen Leben weiterführen wollen. Olivia möchte an Jacksons Seite bleiben. Jackson bezweifelt jedoch, ob ihre Beziehung auch außerhalb des Experiments funktionieren wird.

pr.t: Hochzeit auf den ersten Blick - Australien
pr.d: Die Paare stehen vor der endgültigen Entscheidung und reisen davor in ihre Heimat, um dort mit ihren Angehörigen zu sprechen. Dann finden die Kandidaten heraus, wer sich für eine gemeinsame Zukunft bereit fühlt und welche Paare scheitern.

Das Pärchen Tom und Erin weiß, dass es an der Zeit ist, eine Entscheidung über ihr renovierungsbedürftiges Haus zu treffen. Erin liebt es und möchte bleiben, aber Tom glaubt, dass ihr perfektes Haus nur ein Schnäppchen entfernt ist.

Mark und Vicki wohnen mit ihren Töchtern im oberen Stockwerk ihres Hauses, während der Großvater im unteren Stockwerk wohnt. Vicki glaubt, dass ihr Haus auseinanderfällt und möchte umziehen, aber Mark glaubt, dass das Haus repariert werden kann.

pr.t: Design Down Under - Wohnvisionen in Australien
pr.d: Eine viel beschäftigte Krankenschwester wünscht sich mehr Funktionalität in ihrem Haus aus den 1900er Jahren und bittet Georgia und Richie um Hilfe. Als sie mit der Arbeit beginnen, überdenkt die Kundin ihre Wunschliste und belastet damit ihr Budget.

pr.t: Design Down Under - Wohnvisionen in Australien
pr.d: Clare und Steve leben in Clares ehemaligem Elternhaus. Sie wollen ihr Zuhause renovieren und erhalten Hilfe von Georgia und Richie. Während diese mit dem Umbau beginnen, sucht Georgia in einem Secondhandladen nach einer Glastür für die Veranda.
Dieses Mal zeigt Mary, dass köstliche Gerichte nicht unbedingt ein Vermögen kosten müssen.
Mary zeigt vier köstliche Pasta-Rezepte, die einfach sind, aber enorm viel Geschmack besitzen.

Selena Gomez besucht Lemon Grove, wo sie vom Chef Marcel Vigneron mit drei außergewöhnlichen Gerichten empfangen wird. Selena kreiert ein farbenfrohes Gericht mit ungewöhnlichen Zutaten, und Marcel muss entscheiden, ob es sein neues Special wird.

Selena Gomez besucht Moo's Craft Barbecue in Los Angeles, wo sie die besten Texas BBQ-Gerichte entdeckt. Die Betreiber Andrew und Michelle Muñoz fordern sie heraus, eine eigene Wurst zu kreieren, die eine besondere Note in ihre Speisekarte bringt.
Auf Tasmanien bewundert Gordon Ramsay die Natur und sammelt außergewöhnliche Zutaten für ein regional geprägtes Festessen. Dabei lässt sich der Spitzenkoch auch von Haien und Schlangen nicht stoppen.

Der Spitzenkoch Gordon Ramsay reist in die südafrikanische Provinz KwaZulu-Natal und erfährt mehr über den Umgang mit traditionellen Braai-Holzgrills. Im Indischen Ozean begibt Ramsay sich außerdem auf die Suche nach Muscheln.

Der Ex-Teilnehmer und Sternekoch Egor Hopp ist zu Gast als Juror. Er stellt die Kandidaten vor harte Aufgaben: Die Speisekammern bleiben geschlossen, stattdessen müssen sie mit von ihm gepackten Einkaufskörben und speziellen Einkaufszetteln kochen.
pr.sub: Kleine Produktauswahl, aber großer Geschmack für Egor Hopp

pr.d: Joanna und Chip renovieren ein Haus am Wald, in dem der Sohn eines guten Freundes wohnen soll.

Josh ist musikalisch und möchte die Möglichkeit haben, seiner Leidenschaft auch in den neuen vier Wänden ausüben zu können. Chip und Joanna gestalten für ihn und seiner Frau ein eher unscheinbares Objekt in ein schönes, klassisches Haus um.

Gastjurorin Clara Hunger bringt knifflige Geschmackskombinationen wie knusprige Aubergine oder süßen Schweinebauch mit. Während sie für nachhaltige und innovative Küche steht, treibt Steffen Henssler sein Team beim Teamkochen an.

Der britische Spitzenkoch Gordon Ramsay besucht seinen Kollegen Eric Cook in New Orleans, um mehr über die Grundlagen der Cajun-Küche zu erfahren. Daraus entwickelt sich ein abenteuerlicher Trip durch die Sümpfe Louisianas.

Gordon Ramsay begibt sich auf die indonesische Insel Sumatra, um sich mit der dortigen Kochkunst vertraut zu machen. Bei der Durchquerung eines Höhlensystems und der Begegnung einer Büffelherde ist außerdem voller Körpereinsatz gefragt.

Police respond to a call about a man who is brandishing a samurai sword, destroying his mother's house and threatening to set himself on fire, plus Saturday night fever breaks out in Newcastle.
Ash Bowden is accused of stalking when a woman learns her car will be impounded, an elderly motorcyclist is pulled over for not wearing a helmet, and an unlicensed vehicle is caught speeding.
A police chase becomes a manhunt when officers decide to have a closer look at a car behaving strangely on the road, and discover an unlicensed driver behind the wheel.

An officer inspects a resistant traveller's luggage; no mistaken identities at JFK; an impatient shopper in Detroit; a frequent traveller to drug-sourced countries is questioned; a Canadian cowboy might be a mule.
In a dramatic bust an American man makes a shocking confession and authorities discover a rare and unusual item in a strange package from Russia.
Officers realise that a Chinese man is covering for a partner in crime when he won't answer questions. What he is hiding in his luggage could have a devastating effect on biosecurity.
Dog handler Darryl gets more than he bargained for when he steps in to break up a pub fight in Exeter city centre, and the Ashburton Tactical Aid Group executes two flat raids.
From windy weather wipe-outs and the most villainous of drivers, to moments the police would rather forget, it's all caught on dashcam.
Dom Littlewood looks at clever new methods that the police and the public are using to catch crooks red-handed.
Dom Littlewood looks at clever new methods that the police and the public are using to catch crooks red-handed.
A violent attack on a small village store has a twist in the tale, and two good Samaritans come to the aid of a woman when a handbag snatcher targets her.
From trying to settle the age-old debate of cyclists versus drivers, to witnessing miraculous moments of luck, we've got it all caught on camera.
Two retirees disappear from their home near Rutland Water, and forensic scientists search for evidence to prove that the pair had been murdered.

Christopher Hightower was a killer conman who masqueraded as a church leader and duped people out of thousands of dollars. In 1991, the commodities trader slaughtered a family of three after his friend Ernest Brendel lodged a complaint against him.
Andrew Dawson was given a second life sentence for the unprovoked murders of his two neighbours while he was out on release from prison for the killing of a 91-year-old man in 1982.
When Lanell Barsock is found dead in her home in Palmdale, California, evidence points to her boyfriend before investigating detectives start to focus on her best friend, Larene Austin.
The story of Valerie Graves, a grandmother who was killed in a horrific attack just days after Christmas whilst she was house-sitting for her friends' million-pound property in Bosham in 2013.
A profile of the serial killer known as 'The Gainesville Ripper', who murdered five college students in Gainesville, Florida, creating crime scenes so horrific that he inspired the movie 'Scream'.
In 2017, Randy Herman Jr killed his roommate Brooke Preston when he stabbed her to death in their West Palm Beach, Florida, home and claimed that the attack happened while he was sleepwalking.
Just days after Dawn Walker married Thomas Nutt, the 52-year-old grandmother failed to meet her daughter, before a shocking discovery was made.
In August 2007, the nation was shocked by the tragic murder of 11-year-old Rhys Jones who was shot dead in the Liverpool suburb of Croxteth.
In November 1993, the murders of Samantha and Jazmine Bisset in South London shock the investigators who attend the scene.

Drama about a gay lawyer's fight against unlawful dismissal by his homophobic employer. Forced to lead a double life because of the bigoted views held by his law firm, he discovers he is HIV-positive during a routine medical examination and is soon afterwards is fired for incompetence.

Paul Edgecomb, the head guard of death row, just wants life for him, his colleagues and the condemned to be nice and easy. However, when John Coffey, a massive man convicted of brutally killing a pair of young sisters, arrives, things start to get strange. Beyond his simple, naïve nature and a deathly fear of the dark, Coffey seems to possess a prodigious, supernatural gift. Paul begins to question whether Coffey was truly guilty of murdering the two girls.

Roxy Hart is sent to prison for shooting her lying lover. In prison, she meets tabloid darling and headline singer, Velma Kelly, who is also in for a double murder. With the help of a slick Chicago lawyer, she learns to play the media game and vies for the valuable press attention that will get her out of jail.
Two young men during World War I set out to record the lives, voices and music of their American countrymen.

When a perfect night with a perfect stranger ends suddenly the next morning, Charlotte searches for answers and meaning in her life. However, she soon uncovers a shocking secret that changes everything she knows about the man who captured her heart.

Drama about a gay lawyer's fight against unlawful dismissal by his homophobic employer. Forced to lead a double life because of the bigoted views held by his law firm, he discovers he is HIV-positive during a routine medical examination and is soon afterwards is fired for incompetence.
A grieving Jacqueline Kennedy examines her husband's legacy as America mourns his death.

William Shakespeare and his wife, Agnes, celebrate the birth of their son, Hamnet. However, when tragedy strikes and Hamnet dies at a young age, it inspires Shakespeare to write his timeless masterpiece `Hamlet'.
Young Jim has to grow up fast after the Japanese invade Shanghai. Separated from his parents and alone in a prisoner of war camp, Jim must fight to survive.
Sonny Vaccaro and Nike pursue basketball rookie Michael Jordan, creating a partnership that revolutionises the world of sports and contemporary culture.
The publisher and editor of The Washington Post risk both their careers and freedom to expose a massive cover-up of government secrets that covers three decades and four presidents.

In the 1970s, a 15-year-old boy gets the chance to live out his dream of touring with a band as a rock journalist. The son of a loving but strict single parent, the boy rebels against her distrust of rock music and the surrounding drug culture by writing album reviews which attract sponsorship from a big magazine to tour with a band. Ignoring all advice, he befriends band members and groupies alike.

June is a wildly imaginative girl who finds herself in Wonderland -- an amusement park she created in her mind. With the park falling into disarray, she soon teams up with a group of lovable animals to try and save Wonderland before its lost forever.
Mario, Luigi and Princess Peach embark on an adventure across the galaxy.

Mumble's son Erik hasn't yet found his talents, and he goes with his friends to Adélie-land which is ruled by a penguin who can fly. When Erik returns to Emperor-land and finds them trapped under big walls of ice. Will Erik be able to save his family and friends before it is too late?

A life-saving surgery fuses together a police officer and his faithful police dog -- and Dog Man is born. Learning to embrace his new identity, Dog Man must stop feline supervillain Petey the Cat from cloning himself and going on a crime spree.
Discover some of the very best Sky Originals to watch with the whole family, from 'Monster Family' to 'The Amazing Maurice'.
Mario, Luigi and Princess Peach embark on an adventure across the galaxy.

The story of a reclusive green ogre called Shrek whose life of solitude is disrupted by a horde of refugees who have been banished by the evil Lord Farquaad. Determined to save his home, Shrek cuts a deal with the tyrant, who sets him a daunting task - if Shrek is ever to enjoy peace and quiet again, he must rescue Farquaad's bride-to-be from a dangerous castle. A DreamWorks animation.

Ogre Shrek and his new wife Fiona are surprised to discover a letter from her parents, inviting them over for dinner. Fiona is eager to show off her new husband, but her parents don't yet know she's an ogre. Taking Donkey along, they set off for Far Far Away to visit them, but the trip is hampered by the jealousy of a wicked fairy godmother and her hired assassin, Puss in Boots. A DreamWorks animation.
Mario, Luigi and Princess Peach embark on an adventure across the galaxy.

Shrek is just starting to settle down in his beloved swamp with his wife Fiona, but their mucky bliss doesn't last for long as word arrives that the ogre's froggy father-in-law is about to croak. The very last thing Shrek wants is to become King, but with no other heir in sight, it looks like the grumpy green one is destined never to live quietly in the swamp again. A glimmer of hope appears in the form of heir Artie. A DreamWorks animation.

Looking for the days when he felt like a "real ogre", Shrek makes an ill-advised pact with Rumpelstiltskin. Banished to a Shrek-less version of the land of Far, Far Away, the unfortunate ogre must once again win the love of Princess Fiona if he's to ever get back home. A DreamWorks animation.
Mario, Luigi and Princess Peach embark on an adventure across the galaxy.
A pig, a mouse, a porcupine, a gorilla, an elephant and other animals gather at a koala's theatre for a singing competition.

Peter Rabbit and his three sisters -- Flopsy, Mopsy and Cotton-Tail -- enjoy spending their days in Mr. McGregor's vegetable garden. When one of McGregor's relatives suddenly moves in, he's less than thrilled to discover a family of rabbits in his new home. A battle of wills soon breaks out as the new owner hatches scheme after scheme to get rid of Peter -- a resourceful rabbit who proves to be a worthy and wily opponent.

Spoof spy caper with the eponymous, blundering hero attempting to recover the crown jewels and save Britain from an evil mastermind when all the other agents are killed. Promoted from lowly pen pusher to super spy, Johnny English is baffled when clues lead to respected entrepreneur Pascal Sauvage, but could the enigmatic Lorna hold the key to the mystery?
A haphazard spy returns to MI-7 after years in a Tibetan monastery honing his Zen skills. Armed with gizmos, gadgets and chaotic luck he takes on a global ring of assassins.
A kidnapped family and their two murderous captors confront bloodthirsty demons after crossing the Mexican border.

pr.t: From Dusk Till Dawn 2: Texas Blood Money
pr.d: A bank robber headed for a Mexican heist stumbles into a bar frequented by the undead, where he's turned into a vampire.

Two handymen are forced to postpone their plans to escape their humdrum lives after several mysterious deaths and a series of earthquakes turn out to be the work of predatory subterranean creatures which lay siege to the terrified townsfolk. An affectionate homage to the `creature features' of the 1950s.
Previews of the great films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky.

An alcoholic millionaire is threatened with losing his inheritance if he does not marry the girl of his parents' choosing. Despite his dislike for his prospective bride, he bows to the inevitable only to meet a light-fingered waitress who steals his heart. John Gielgud won an Oscar for his role as Arthur's loyal but outspoken valet.

pr.t: See No Evil, Hear No Evil
pr.d: Lighthearted adventures of a pair of news vendors in New York - one deaf, one blind - who go on the run when they are blamed for the murder of a customer. Each has seen - or heard - just a whiff of a clue, and a frantic chase ensues as the duo struggle to clear their names.

Danny Noonan, a teen down on his luck, works as a caddy at the snob-infested Bushwood Country Club to raise money for his college education. In an attempt to gain votes for a college scholarship reserved for caddies, Noonan volunteers to caddy for a prominent and influential club member. Meanwhile, Danny struggles to prepare for the high pressure Caddy Day golf tournament while absorbing New Age advice from wealthy golf guru Ty Webb.

Despite his dislike for his prospective bride, he bows to the inevitable only to meet a light-fingered waitress who steals his heart. John Gielgud won an Oscar for his role as Arthur's loyal but outspoken valet.

An unconventional sleuth attempts to find a football team's stolen mascot dolphin. The Miami 🏈 [NFL] Dolphins are aghast when their beloved Snowflake is abducted one week before the all-important Super Bowl, so they call in Ace Ventura, a private eye who uses unorthodox methods to retrieve missing animals.

Legendary pet detective Ace Ventura returns for another adventure when he's coerced out of retirement while on a soul-searching retreat in the Himalayas. He must now retrieve an endangered white bat from a village located in Africa. The sacred animal was offered up as a wedding dowry from the Wachootoo prince to the Wachati princess, and, if Ace can't track down the culprit behind the kidnapping in time, civil war will break out between the two rival tribes.

Fastidious businessman Neal Page and slobbish shower-curtain salesman Del Griffith are the reluctant odd couple trying to get home from New York to Chicago to be with their families at Thanksgiving. Their thwarted travel plans keep throwing them together.

The most famous actress in the world. A second hand bookshop owner in Notting Hill. After colliding in the street they begin a relationship which is soon fraught with complications as the tabloid press hound her. He must then summon all his charm, ingenuity and patience if there is to be a happy ending.

Believing it essential before they go to college, four teenage boys vow to lose their virginity and enter into a pact, each attempting to be the first to do the deed as their efforts are met with varying levels of success and failure.

A tough cop is forced to go undercover as a kindergarten teacher. In his new role, he must track down a mother and son who are the only witnesses against a drug-dealing criminal, who is also their husband and father. The cop uses his brutal methods to negotiate the mundane problems of child control.

Katniss Everdeen finds herself in District 13 after she destroys the Games forever. Under the leadership of President Coin and the advice of her trusted friends, Katniss spreads her wings as she fights to save Peeta and a nation moved by her courage.

Two aquatic misfits embark on an impossible journey to save their home.

A couple realize their relationship has reached a crossroads while on holiday in Amsterdam. After so much time and so many memories, long-held promises and deeply concealed wounds threaten to come to light and force them to confront their future.

Released from prison, Kenna tries to reunite with her daughter, but her custodial grandparents refuse to let her see her. She soon finds unexpected compassion from a local bar owner as their secret romance gives Kenna hope for a second chance.

A few weeks into their van life adventure, a young couple witnesses an accident that leaves the driver dead. Soon, they're being pursued by a demonic stalker who's impossible to outrun and follows them wherever they go.

Free Eden employee Apple secretly runs a witchy femme cult in the basement of a mall store after hours. When a new hire challenges their performative sisterhood, the women are forced to face their own poisons or succumb to a bloody fate.

A couple is shocked when their missing daughter is returned to them after disappearing eight years earlier. However, what should be a joyful family reunion soon turns into a living nightmare as she starts to transform into something truly horrifying.

Cal Lynch travels back in time to 15th-century Spain through a revolutionary technology that unlocks the genetic memories contained in his DNA. There, he lives out the experiences of Aguilar de Nerha, a distant relative who's also a member of the Assassins, a secret society that fights to protect free will from the power-hungry Templar Order. Transformed by the past, Cal begins to gain the knowledge and physical skills necessary to battle the oppressive organisation in the present.

Hilarity and horror ensue when toothy, carnivorous aliens escape from their space prison, pursued by two merciless bounty hunters. When they reach the Kansas farmhouse of an all-American family, the humans do everything they can to fend off the critters, but they cannot free themselves of the ferocious outsiders.
This week's edition of the Cinema List is all about Killers. From 'Scream 7' to 'The Conjuring: Last Rites', prepare for blood-curdling sequels and some seriously sinister scares.

In 2274, computers rule a hermetically sealed city housing the survivors of a holocaust that has decimated the earth. Life is hedonistic and happy for the city's inhabitants; unfortunately they must be terminated when they reach 30. When Logan 5, a trained hunter for the system, grows intrigued by a beautiful young woman, he is forced to question the fundamental principles of his society and decides he must flee.

Callous bureaucrat Wikus van de Merwe helps evict a group of aliens from a Johannesburg shanty town, but has to go on the run when he becomes infected after being exposed to their technology.
The maiden voyage of the third Starship Enterprise is jeopardised by mad scientist Soran. Only one man knows how to stop the boffin, but he's been dead 78 years.
Picard and his crew face a Borg offensive as they try to ensure that a 21st-century scientist keeps a date with destiny.

A Federation mission to the planet Ba'ku takes a dangerous turn when a malfunctioning android, Data, takes a cultural task force hostage. When Capt. Picard and his crew investigate, they uncover the truth about the Federation mission: It was actually a systematic ploy by the Son'a to displace the peaceful inhabitants of Ba'ku. Now Picard and his crew must thwart the plot even while experiencing strange side effects from exposure to the planet's surface.

Working for a highly funded yet unofficial government agency, Kay and Jay are the Men in Black, providers of immigration services and regulators of all things alien on Earth. While investigating a series of unregistered close encounters, the MIB agents uncover the deadly plot of an intergalactic terrorist who is on a mission to assassinate two ambassadors from opposing galaxies currently in residence in New York City.

Captain Picard and his crew are sent to the planet Romulus, where a new leader, Shinzon, wishes to make peace with the Federation. Upon arriving at the planet, Picard discovers Shinzon's plan is to destroy the Enterprise with his powerful craft the Scimitar and then advance on a defenceless Earth. Picard must use all his cunning to outwit his adversary but faces an obstacle: Shinzon is a younger clone of himself.
A group of friends must confront their most terrifying fears when they awaken the dark powers of an ancient spirit board.

In 1957, a boy named Jason Voorhees drowned while staying at Camp Crystal Lake, due to the negligence of the staff. The next year, two camp counsellors were killed, and the camp was closed. A few years later, fires and other problems prevented the camp from reopening. In 1979, ignoring the camp curse, a new owner opens the place, and before long, a mysterious figure is stalking the area, and once again, people are being murdered.

Luther Krank, fed up with the commercialism of Christmas, decides to skip the holiday and go on holiday with his wife, an easy decision to make with their daughter away anyway, but when she suddenly decides to come home, uproar ensues in the rush to celebrate Christmas at the last minute.
Santa's clumsy son Arthur must save the day when his dad's present delivery system misses someone out. Festive animation with the voices of James McAvoy and Bill Nighy.
All a retired widower wants for Christmas is for his family to get along. If they can honour his wish and spend five whole, happy days together, it may just be a Christmas miracle.
Santa's oversized helper Will Ferrell goes to New York to find his real dad, only to discover he's a mean old grouch. Hit comedy with Zooey Deschanel.
Two worlds collide when a music manager of a boy band and the guitarist in a death metal group connect over a Christmas hit they both desperately need.
Anxious to get home for the holidays, exec Steve Martin is forced to hit the road with sales oaf John Candy. Classic comic caper. Strong language/flashing images.
Previews of the great films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky.
Hard-partying TJ Miller tries to save his struggling IT branch by inviting a big-spending client to a wild office bash. Comedy with Jennifer Aniston.

Everyone knows that, each Christmas, Santa Claus delivers presents to every last child on Earth. What everyone doesn't know is that Santa accomplishes the feat with a very high-tech operation beneath the North Pole. But when the unthinkable happens, and Santa misses one child out of hundreds of millions, someone has to save the day. It's up to Arthur, Santa's youngest son, to deliver a present to the forgotten tyke before Christmas morning dawns.
Tim Allen and Jamie Lee Curtis cause uproar in their Christmas-crazy suburb when they give the festivities a miss. Dingdong comedy, based on a John Grisham story.

Finding out that he's actually human, Buddy the elf leaves the North Pole to find his real dad in bustling New York, but when he gets there, his mean old dad doesn't want to know. While he's trying to convince his father, he gets a job as a department store elf, which he should be perfectly cut out for.
Crowd-pleasing festive comedy starring Danny Glover as the widowed patriarch of a dysfunctional clan gathering together for the holidays. With Oscar winner Mo'Nique.
As his life unravels around him just in time for Christmas, Bernard dusts off an antique jewellery box that happens to contain trapped genie Flora, who might just be able to help him.
Mario, Luigi and Princess Peach embark on an adventure across the galaxy.
Two worlds collide when a music manager and a guitarist connect over a Christmas hit they both desperately need. A Sky Original film.

A gadget salesman is looking for a special gift for his son and finds one at a store in Chinatown. The shopkeeper is reluctant to sell him the 'mogwai' but sells it to him with the warning to never expose him to bright light, water, or to feed him after midnight. All of this happens and the result is a gang of gremlins that decide to tear up the town on Christmas Eve.

Dumped and depressed, English rose Iris agrees to swap homes with similarly unlucky in love Californian Amanda for a much-needed break. Iris finds herself in a palatial Hollywood mansion while Amanda navigates the lanes of a picture-perfect English village. Soon enough, both lovelorn ladies bump into local lads perfect for a romantic pick-me-up.

After Claire inherits her uncle's Christmas-themed bar, she must square off against a neighbouring competitor to save it from its drowning debt.
Richard Curtis' Sky Original festive comedy about a genie, a man and landing a chance to fix the mess you've made of life. Melissa McCarthy and Paapa Essiedu star.

The Grinch and his loyal dog, Max, live a solitary existence inside a cave on Mount Crumpet. His main source of aggravation comes during Christmastime when his neighbours in Whoville celebrate the holidays with a bang. When the Whos decide to make Christmas bigger and brighter, the disgruntled Grinch realises there is one way to gain peace and quiet. With help from Max, the green grump hatches a scheme to pose as Santa Claus, steal Christmas and silence the Whos' holiday cheer once and for all.
In The Super Mario Galaxy Movie, Mario and crew blast off on an epic journey and encounter new worlds, iconic characters and unexpected threats.
